extracted.intended_audience: public information officers (PIOs) in law enforcement, agency supervisors/decision-makers considering membership
extracted.subtask_description: Information about the IACP Public Information Officers Section, its value to PIOs and agencies, and the skills/activities promoted (training, networking, awards, sponsorship). Intended to help PIOs justify membership to supervisors and to highlight professional development opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotion of exchange of information and training
rubrics_metrics.description: The PIO Section promotes the exchange of information and training among officers responsible for planning and implementing effective public information programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section activity focus: information exchange and training for officers who plan and implement public information programs; implies value placed on peer learning and professional development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support understanding of membership value to supervisors/decision-makers
rubrics_metrics.description: This document is intended to support understanding of the value of membership to the IACP and the Public Information Officer (PIO) Section to your supervisor or to the decision makers at your agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance to PIOs: frame membership benefits in terms of organizational advantage (institutional knowledge, community benefit) when communicating with supervisors or agency leaders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Building institutional knowledge for media relations
rubrics_metrics.description: As a member of the Public Information Officer Section, you quickly learn valuable skills that help build institutional knowledge when it comes to working relationships with media representatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes development of durable, agency-level capability in media relations through membership activities and training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing community-appropriate social media strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Membership helps PIOs learn social media strategies that work for your communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on practical, community-tailored social media approaches rather than one-size-fits-all tactics; membership resources and peer exchange are the vehicle for learning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hands-on training at annual conferences
rubrics_metrics.description: Hands-on training at annual conferences provides you with immediate skills that you can in turn employ at your agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values experiential learning delivered at conferences; immediate, operational applicability of skills is emphasized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leadership in Public Information Management Award — effective dissemination
rubrics_metrics.description: The IACP Leadership in Public Information Management Award recognizes the accomplishments of an individual public information officer and his or her ability to effectively disseminate information to the public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Award criterion centers on demonstrated accomplishment and measurable ability to disseminate information effectively to the public; contact Member Engagement Team for more information.
